title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 9-12 (Vak, Padmalaya, Padma, Shuchi)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 9 to 12: Vak, Padmalaya, Padma, Shuchi, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 9 to 12 with meaning
caption: Names 9 to 12 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 9 to 12**: **Vak, Padmalaya, Padma, Shuchi**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Vak, Padmalaya, Padma, Shuchi.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Vak** means **Speech**. Sweet and truthful speech brings respect and prosperity.
**Padmalaya** means **Dweller in the Lotus**. Lakshmi is shown seated or standing on a lotus.
**Padma** means **The Lotus**. The lotus grows in mud yet stays clean: purity in the middle of worldly life.
**Shuchi** means **The Pure One**. She is said to stay where there is cleanliness, inside and outside.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
